venue: Half pitch (full pitch for blocks 2, 4 and 5)
theme: Occupy and vacate: when someone moves, move into their space
focus: In possession: 9 drops, 8 runs beyond on the blind side and becomes the temporary 9; the far-side 8 fills the striker's spot to keep two in the central lane
objectives: 8 moves away to drag their CM, 9 drops into the gap, 8 then runs beyond on the blind side to become the temporary 9
CB and FB find the diagonal pass into the dropping 9 or onto the 8's back foot
Far-side 8 fills the centre so we keep two players in the central lane, and the 9 sets or plays round the corner
key_messages: "Someone moves, I move" - fill the space they leave
"Diagonal" - break lines with the diagonal pass, not the straight one
"Round the corner" - one-touch layoff into the run

blocks.title: Box pass and replace

diagram.caption: x2 grids. Central 9 drops to receive, the 8 fills the space they left, ball goes into the new central player. 2 defenders (not shown) passive, then live.

blocks.setup: Two 20x20m grids, 8 per grid: 4 on the corners, 2 in the middle (the 9 and 8) and 2 defenders who are passive for the first 5 minutes, then live.
how: Central 9 drops towards the ball and receives; the 8 immediately runs into the space the 9 left.
9 lays it back to a corner or plays straight into the 8 in the new space.
8 plays out to the far corner; the 2 central players now repeat from the other side.
Every 90 seconds the central pair swap with the defenders, then with 2 corner players.
blocks.link_to_theme: Introduces the core rule of the session: when someone vacates a space, someone else occupies it.
coaching_points: Drop with a check: move away first, then come short at an angle
Filling player arrives as the ball goes into the dropping player, not after
Corner players receive on the open side ready to play into the middle first time
blocks.activity_notes: Two grids at once; roles rotate every 90 seconds so everyone gets the central role.

blocks.title: Drop and go: 9 drops, 8 becomes the 9

diagram.caption: x2 (one unit on each half). 8 drags their CM away, 9 drops, 8 runs beyond on the blind side. CB chooses: 9 to feet, or diagonal onto the 8's back foot.

blocks.setup: Two units, one on each half. Per unit: CB, two 8s, 9 (blue) vs their CM and 2 CBs (red) + GK. Coach feeds the CB from the halfway line.
how: Near 8 moves away from the ball, taking their CM with them.
9 drops into the gap between lines. If their CM jumps to the 9, the 8 spins on the blind side into the striker's spot.
CB reads it: pass into the 9 to turn (CM stayed with the 8) or diagonal onto the 8's back foot (CM jumped to the 9).
Far 8 comes inside into the centre to keep two in the central lane; 9 can set to them first time.
Finish with a shot. Red CBs passive for 6 minutes, then live.
blocks.link_to_theme: Teaches the 'temporary 9' rotation from the video and the diagonal passes that unlock it.
coaching_points: 9 drops on an angle so they can see the CB and the goal - not straight back
8 runs on their CM's blind side: behind them, out of their eyeline
Diagonal pass beats the line; a straight pass into a marked 9 doesn't
9 receiving under pressure: one-touch round the corner into the run, don't try to turn
questions: Their CM went with our 9: where's the space?
Why is a diagonal pass better here than a straight one?
progressions: Add their second CM (blue 4 v red 4 + GK)
regressions: Coach tells the CM to follow the 9 or the 8 before the rep
blocks.activity_notes: Two units of 7 on separate halves plus 2 spare players who feed and swap in every 3 reps.

blocks.title: 3-zone game: break the line with a dropping 9

diagram.caption: Blue build from zone 1, must play through zone 2 (their midfield) to score. A ball into a player who arrived in a space a teammate just left = bonus point.

blocks.setup: Half pitch split into 3 zones. Blue 7 (2 CBs, 2 FBs, two 8s, 9). Red 6 (3 mids in zone 2, 3 defenders in the attacking zone) + GK. Red mids must stay in zone 2; 3 spare players rotate in every 4 minutes.
how: Coach feeds a blue CB in zone 1. Blue must get the ball through zone 2 (a pass or a carry) before they can attack the goal.
Goal = 1. Bonus point for any pass that breaks zone 2 into a player who arrived in a space a teammate just left.
Red win the ball: play into a coach on the halfway line = 1 point for red.
After 10 minutes, one red mid can follow the dropping 9 out of zone 2.
blocks.link_to_theme: Forces the drop-and-go rotation, because a static 9 or 8 won't get through a compact red midfield.
coaching_points: The first movement creates the space, the second one uses it
Look for the third player: 9 drops, sets, the 8 who ran beyond receives
CBs: be patient, move the ball side to side until the rotation opens the diagonal
Far-side 8 tucks in to keep two in the central lane
progressions: Red mids can leave zone 2 freely
regressions: Remove the red point for a turnover
blocks.activity_notes: Rotation every 4 minutes; waiting group of 3 does a 2v1 pass-and-replace on the side of the pitch so nobody stands still.

blocks.title: 8v8 + GKs: rotation bonus game

diagram.caption: 8v8 + GKs on full pitch. Goal from a temporary 9 (any player who arrived in the striker's spot after the 9 dropped) = 2.

blocks.setup: Full pitch, 8v8 + GKs. Each team: 2 CBs, LB, 6, two 8s, 9, RW. Yellow '9 spot' cones in each attacking 23 as a visual cue.
how: Restarts always from the GK to a CB.
Goal = 1. Goal scored or assisted by a temporary 9 (a player who arrived in the striker's spot after the 9 dropped) = 2.
Coach freeze once every 4 minutes on a good or missed 'someone moves, I move' moment.
Final 5 minutes: free play.
blocks.link_to_theme: Live recognition of when the striker's spot has been vacated and who needs to fill it.
coaching_points: Somebody must always be in the 9 spot when we're in the final third
Weeks 1 and 2 still apply: two per lane, FB in / 8 out / W in
Dropping 9 plays one or two touch - don't get turned over in midfield
progressions: Double points only if the move started with a diagonal pass
regressions: Neutral floater for the team in possession
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone plays; ball-stocks behind both goals.

blocks.title: 11v11 (or numbers available): someone moves, I move
blocks.setup: Full pitch match, normal rules. Swap bibs at 10 minutes.
how: Normal game.
Focus: when a teammate leaves a space, fill it within 2 seconds.
Coach tallies diagonal passes that break a line.
coaching_points: The 9 spot is never empty in the final third
Diagonal into the back foot of the runner
questions: When our 9 dropped, who went? Was anybody left in the centre?

safety: Shin guards and gum shields for all
Shots from inside the circle only, on the floor in blocks 2-3
reflection_prompts: Did the 8s run on the blind side, or in front of their marker?
Were the CBs patient enough to wait for the diagonal?
Is the far-side 8 tucking in, or is the centre left empty?
